steps.text: Cut the okra into rounds and dry-roast in a pan for 5 minutes to reduce stickiness.
steps.cue: The okra pieces look dry and slightly browned, with no sticky strings.
steps.tip: Dry the okra completely after washing. Wet okra turns slimy.

steps.text: Fry cumin and onion in the oil, add tomato and spices and cook to a paste.
steps.cue: Onion golden brown at the edges, tomato broken into a thick paste with oil shimmering at the sides.

steps.text: Add okra and chickpeas, cover and cook 8 minutes, then finish with lemon.
steps.cue: The okra is tender when a knife goes in and the masala clings to the pieces.
